title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-30
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording captures a landmark Dark Star and the first Tighten Up jam, showcasing a triumphant performance despite Jerry's broken string.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as a major turning point, with a soaring Dark Star that pushes the band's improvisational boundaries and an early Tighten Up (Soulful Strut) jam that hints at new directions. Although Jerry Garcia’s guitar suffered a broken string, his recovery fuels a radiant, triumphant passage that reviewers describe as unforgettable.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed review is overwhelmingly positive about the musical performance and implies good soundboard quality; limited data yields lower confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; as a soundboard source it is presumed clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance builds from a daring Dark Star into a tightly woven jam, highlighting the band's evolving interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar string broke early, but his recovery was remarkable and added to the triumphant feel.
